title: The Silent Harbor
text: The Silent Harbor is a 1998 novel by Maria Duarte. It won the Coastal Prize.

title: Maria Duarte
text: Maria Duarte is a Portuguese novelist. She was born in Lisbon in 1961.

title: Porto
text: Porto is a city in northern Portugal.

title: Veloria
text: Veloria is a fictional country whose capital is Castrel.

title: Castrel
text: Castrel is the largest city of Veloria.  The Amber River flows through Castrel.

title: Lisbon
text: Lisbon is the capital of Portugal.
